scope: Focused action-by-action and scenario-by-scenario review. Modeled projection identifies a corresponding rule only. Complete behavior equivalence, source replay, live conformance and untouched retained models remain unestablished.

init.reason: Starts signed out. A fixed synthetic obligation is moved to the separate funded-rights policy.

join.reason: Ordinary authenticated sign-in and explicit reopening are separate and preserve permanent actor ID.

otherSession.reason: Sign-in with a fresh session ID appends a separate active session.

connectX.reason: A live session and external OAuth evidence connect a permanently reserved X identity.

optIn.reason: Two independent consent purposes bind to account and current session.

revoke.reason: The successor adds live caller checks to target revocation and separate current-session sign-out.

close.reason: Confirmed closure clears all sessions, X visibility and consent, while the wallet/payment policies own retained obligations.

step.reason: Vibestack generates event dispatch and enabled guards from transitions.

closureTest.reason: Account model checks session and X/consent outcome. Funded rights are separately specified, with no account-close-to-settlement conformance trace yet.

reopenTest.reason: Explicit reopening restores public membership without reconnecting X.

currentSignoutTest.reason: Per-session sign-out differs from closing every session.

init.reason: Navigation starts without private rows, but no set of separately opened report-detail identities exists.

openFirst.reason: No per-submission detail/card mount transition or deterministic accessible heading IDs.

openSecond.reason: No second concurrent report detail, so references cannot be checked for collisions.

closeFirst.reason: No independent report-detail closure preserving its sibling.

closeSecond.reason: No independent report-detail closure preserving its sibling.

accountChanges.reason: Existing composition clears one draft and private row count. It cannot clear a set of mounted detail instances because that set is absent.

step.reason: Legacy closed finite dispatcher is retained. Successor lacks its sibling-detail state.

bothOpenKeepDistinctReferencesTest.reason: Missing two-report simultaneous detail and DOM-reference uniqueness contract.

accountChangeRemovesBothTest.reason: Current account reset covers aggregate rows and one draft only.

init.reason: Single frontend request starts empty. It has no shared consumer subscriptions or cache identity.

acquire.reason: One request opens. No concurrent consumer joins the same pending request.

cacheHit.reason: No distinct validated shared cache hit or consumer-local view attachment.

force.reason: No separate forced replacement generation that invalidates shared cache while preserving each visible record.

release.reason: No exact read/consumer unbind preserving a newer binding.

flushRelease.reason: No deferred last-consumer cancellation, or rejoin before deferred abort.

failure.reason: A single failed read preserves its snapshot, without distinct cache and consumer-local state.

complete.reason: Resource/lifetime/request guard blocks a stale consumer result. Independent cache and consumer commit behavior is absent.

step.reason: Legacy tie and subscription dispatcher retained. The active model generates its single-resource dispatcher.

failedForcedRefreshKeepsVisibleRecordTes.reason: Single stale view is modeled, but cache eviction and unchanged consumer output are not independent.

replacedEffectCannotAcceptOldReadTest.reason: A stale request cannot overwrite a new resource/lifetime. There is no same-resource forced generation with two requests in flight.

oldCleanupCannotUnbindNewReadTest.reason: Missing per-consumer and per-request cleanup identity.

cachedMountTest.reason: Missing cache-hit attach for a second consumer.

oldReadCannotReplaceRefreshCacheTest.reason: Missing shared cache newest-generation write fence.

replacementEffectCanJoinBeforeAbortTest.reason: Missing deferred release and replacement consumer rejoin.

lastConsumerAbortsTest.reason: Missing last-consumer ownership test before transport abort.

init.reason: No invocation state independently tracks command, request cleanup, publication and report release.

command.reason: No nonzero versus thrown outcome, captured output or primary process error.

cleanupRequest.reason: No exact owned request cleanup or first-failure precedence.

classify.reason: No report publication disposition after request cleanup.

release.reason: No outer lease release, terminal status or preservation of existing failure.

step.reason: Legacy argument enumeration and dispatch only.

cleanSuccessTest.reason: Missing successful invocation plus both successful cleanups.

nonzeroCommandSurvivesRequestCleanupTest.reason: Missing retained nonzero output and command failure precedence.

thrownCommandSurvivesRequestCleanupTest.reason: Missing thrown command identity and failure precedence.

primaryDiscoveryErrorSurvivesReleaseTest.reason: Missing release failure with already recorded command error.

bothCleanupsPreserveCommandFailureTest.reason: Missing independent cleanup failure retention and first command error.

successfulCommandFailsOnRequestCleanupTe.reason: Missing terminal failure after request cleanup, even with command success.

successfulReportFailsOnReleaseTest.reason: Missing distinction between published report and failing invocation release.

earlierCleanupErrorSurvivesReleaseTest.reason: Missing first cleanup failure surviving later release failure.

init.reason: Installer starts idle; the role-and-binding transport lifecycle has no initialization.

selectRole.reason: Static, generated contributor and generated reviewer admission predicates differ; installation currently has no role state.

fetch.reason: Download stage exists, but endpoint/caller ownership and bounded transient transport attempts are absent.

transient.reason: No transport retry phase or bounded retry accounting.

integrityFailure.reason: Invalid bytes cannot verify. The same invocation does not distinguish integrity refusal from transport retry.

complete.reason: Complete immutable tree admits verification. No transport done/error result state.

compare.reason: Canonical tree and D1 digest checks exist for the generated install flow, without separate role binding and independent file/blob observations.

currentProject.reason: A permission fact gates installation. Reviewer-versus-contributor treatment of project openness is not represented.

admit.reason: Generated installation admission requires D1 digest and current permission, without role-specific admission or credential transport.

step.reason: Legacy transport and role simulator dispatcher.

transientMayRetryTest.reason: Missing bounded transport retry and later admission.

digestFailureCannotRetryTest.reason: Mismatching digest refuses verification, but error class has no effect on retry policy.

extraFileRefusedTest.reason: Complete-tree predicate must refuse an extra file and binds exact GitHub bytes.

pausedProjectRefusedTest.reason: Contributor install takes current permission to begin and verify. Adapter must derive it from current restrictions.

staticSkillNeedsNoRegistryTest.reason: No static artifact route without generated project binding.

staticSkillRejectsRegistryBindingTest.reason: No static role with explicit registry-binding refusal.

reviewerDoesNotRequireOpenProjectTest.reason: No authorized reviewer-only signed manifest branch distinct from contributor install clearance.

reviewerStillNeedsManifestTest.reason: Manifest digest gates generated install generally. No independent reviewer role.

contributorNeedsBindingTest.reason: Contributor install requires approved D1 digest and rendered bytes.

reviewerNeedsBindingTest.reason: The digest requirement is generic and reviewer role is not a state.

staticSkillStillNeedsExactBytesTest.reason: Missing static artifact path with byte check independent of a project registry.

init.reason: Starts with no active version, process lock or staged target.

begin.reason: Only unlocked alive process with valid revision and permission can begin. Ordinary and explicit rollback choose distinct revision guards.

stageArchive.reason: Download separates verification admission, but per-invocation work roots and staged archive cleanup are absent.

verifyBytes.reason: Canonical tree and approved digest are checked, but equal rendered bytes versus equal pair identity have no distinct state.

noChange.reason: No byte-identical no-change outcome preserving active template identity.

retain.reason: Selected pair is appended, with no retained-directory reuse versus physical move outcome.

prepareLink.reason: Only retained verified target under a live lock may prepare relative-link activation.

activate.reason: Publication commits active target only under verified atomic relative rename.

confirmReadback.reason: Current committed target requires readback before complete.

printSuccess.reason: Completion and readback are represented, but success output and subsequent cleanup are not independently modeled.

failure.reason: Generic failure preserves active version, but no per-phase primary diagnostic and cleanup ordering.

linkFailure.reason: Phase can fail without committing, but temporary-link ownership/cleanup choice is missing.

readbackFailure.reason: Failure after commit leaves active pair at the committed target.

cleanup.reason: A failure flag is retained, but cleanup actions cannot record per-invocation roots, staged candidate removal or separate cleanup error.

finish.reason: Lock held through readback, but no separate command exit and cleanup result.

permission.reason: Permission is an evidence input at begin/verification rather than an idle authority observation.

step.reason: Vibestack dispatch covers the active installation transitions, with differing abstraction boundaries.

olderTemplateNewerPolicyTest.reason: Template ancestry is ignored. Ordinary registry revision cannot decrease.

explicitRollbackTest.reason: Retained pair and current permission recheck precede rollback commit.

interruptedActivationTest.reason: Process loss before atomic commit leaves original active pair.

cleanupFailureAfterCommitTest.reason: Failure leaves committed target, but successful readback followed by cleanup failure remains conflated.

cleanupFailureThenSameVersionRetryTest.reason: Retry allowed after failure. Same pair reuse/no-change does not have its own effect path.

readbackFailureLeavesCommittedTargetTest.reason: Readback failure cannot roll back an already activated pair.

readbackFailureThenVerifiedRetryTest.reason: Re-verification allowed but retained reuse and a retry readback without re-publication are absent.

rollbackReadbackFailureKeepsRollbackComm.reason: A committed older retained target stays active on later failure.

failedTemporaryLinkCleanupRetainsOnlyOwn.reason: No owned artifact collection or selective cleanup.

retryReusesRetainedVersionTest.reason: Retains pair history but appends the same pair rather than modeling physical reuse.

refusalBeforeStagingCreatesNoTemporaryAr.reason: Pre-begin permission is gated, but there are no modeled roots/artifacts to assert untouched.

cleanupFailurePreservesEarlierErrorTest.reason: Missing primary error and later cleanup diagnostic distinction.

readbackAndCleanupFailureKeepsPrimaryTes.reason: Missing readback failure priority over cleanup error.

noChangeCleanupFailureDoesNotClaimNewAct.reason: Missing byte-identity no-change, readback and cleanup outcomes.

init.reason: No local measured-run durable completion journal, lease owner or trace intent sequence.

start.reason: Work selection begins a contribution, while optional local run creation and usage availability are absent.

prepareFinish.reason: Missing immutable completion candidate from current run, timestamp and optional usage.

rejectCandidate.reason: Missing separately retained invalid completion response.

publish.reason: Missing atomic compare-and-publish for local completion receipt.

competingFinishWins.reason: Missing concurrent completion winner and replay/no overwrite.

removeTemporary.reason: Missing selected completion-artifact cleanup and failure.

removeActive.reason: Missing failure recovery after retained completion with active local record.

precommitFailure.reason: Missing return to active local run after completion failure.

replayCompleted.reason: Missing exact receipt replay preserving prior complete bytes and recovering stale artifacts.

observeInvalidHistoricalRecord.reason: Missing invalid prior receipt reported distinctly from absent record.

reuseUploaded.reason: Missing remote exact digest comparison when an upload already exists.

finalizeTrace.reason: Missing separate attached/finalized remote lifecycle after durable upload.

lostTraceResponse.reason: Missing response uncertainty preserving remote server state and retry identity.

refuseChangedTrace.reason: Upload digest immutability has no cross-attempt compare against the durable remote identity.

registerOpened.reason: PR attribution requires exact authenticated run, but independent server intent identity is not modeled.

selectTrace.reason: Contributor selects inspected exact bytes under scoped consent.

register.reason: Bounded upload begins under a verified session, without separate remote intent registration.

upload.reason: Persistent storage requires original digest and durable object, without uncertainty across independent writes.

recordPullRequest.reason: Records exact submitted PR node only for a verified author session and project.

step.reason: Legacy scheduler dispatch retained to exercise interleavings absent in active simplified workflow.

optionalEvidenceDoesNotBlockReceiptTest.reason: Contribution submission is independent of optional upload and receipt signing may proceed, but local finish persistence is missing.

recordBeforeFinalizationTest.reason: PR run event can record independently of optional trace storage, but distinct server trace finalization is absent.

openedDoesNotNeedMeasuredRunTest.reason: Authenticated submit/run event has no local measured-run prerequisite.

backwardClockCannotPoisonCompletedRecord.reason: Missing monotonic clock/retained local receipt after completion.

invalidCandidateCannotPublishTest.reason: Missing candidate validation and atomic local publication.

cleanupFailureLeavesValidReplayTest.reason: Missing candidate cleanup failure after completed receipt.

activeRemovalFailureCanReplayTest.reason: Missing active local-record cleanup and receipt replay.

concurrentFinishPreservesFirstWinnerTest.reason: Missing first writer atomic finish and competing completion.

traceRetryUsesStoredDigestTest.reason: Missing idempotent remote retry against stored digest.

changedTraceCannotReplaceUploadTest.reason: A single upload verifies its original digest, with no prior remote receipt or retry context.

openedRetryIdentityIsSeparateTest.reason: Missing independent PR-opened intent idempotency key and recovery.
